# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 108 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 108

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever drinks from my mouth will become like me; I myself will become that person, and what is hidden will be disclosed to him."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Will be disclosed" — the passive of revelation; what is hidden will be made known
- "What is hidden" — the hidden things as a category
- The mutual transformation is preserved in the sequence
